_readme: THE PROMISE REGISTER. Every capability the owner has said a paid tier
INCLUDES, recorded as data with its provenance, so that the claim can be
checked against the entitlement model by a program instead of by a reader.
This file is a REQUIREMENT, not a source of truth about what is granted.
tools/check-subscription-claims.mjs compares each entry against the engine's
src/lib/entitlement.js and REFUSES (exit 1) when the model does not actually
grant it to the tiers named here. The subscription page never renders from
this file -- it renders from the model -- so a promise recorded here and not
yet built cannot reach a customer as a claim. It can only make the guard red.
Adding an entry here is how you say 'the product owes this'. Removing one is
how you say 'the owner withdrew it'. Neither is how you make the guard pass:
the way to make it pass is to declare the capability in GATED_CAPABILITIES.

promises.statedAs: website access is a paid-tier entitlement, equivalent to mobile phone access, included with its tier
